work: Qualified J-SKY at AEON Mall Jakarta Garden City as a standalone Ferris wheel; created a page with eight localized descriptions, official operating hours and two exact reusable photographs; published the site and Facebook post; retained the original Indonesian backlog line.
qualification: AEON Mall lists J-SKY as its own attraction on its third floor and provides its operating and last-ticket times. Jakarta Tourism confirms the rooftop wheel, enclosed air-conditioned cabins and location. Official Park and StandaloneAttraction searches for J-Sky and Jakarta Garden City in ID found no matches before creation. The mall is a shopping centre, not a structured amusement park.

officialFacts.location: AEON Mall Jakarta Garden City, third floor rooftop, Jl. Jakarta Garden City Boulevard No. 1, East Jakarta 13910

sourceLimitations: AEON Mall official guide says the wheel operates 10:00–22:00 with last ticket order at 21:00; Jakarta Tourism lists 10:00–21:00, likely the last-ticket interval. The mall schedule was used and the distinction explained.
No current operator-confirmed price was found. Third-party prices differ and a reseller currently marks tickets sold out; no numeric tariff was entered.
The photographs show the exact wheel in March 2026 and November 2021, respectively.
